93→class WebshopEnv:
94→    """Webshop环境类"""
95→    
96→    def __init__(self, webshop_url=WEBSHOP_URL):
97→        self.webshop_url = webshop_url
98→        self.sessions = {}
99→    
100→    def step(self, session, action):
101→        """执行一步动作"""
102→        done = False
103→        observation_ = None
104→        
105→        if action == 'reset':
106→            self.sessions[session] = {'session': session, 'page_type': 'init'}
107→        elif action.startswith('think['):
108→            observation = 'OK.'
109→        elif action.startswith('search['):
110→            if self.sessions[session]['page_type'] != 'init':
111→                observation_ = "Please click the [Back to Search] button to return to the search page before performing a new search."
112→                return observation_, 0.0, False
113→            query = action[7:-1]
114→            self.sessions[session] = {
115→                'session': session, 
116→                'page_type': 'search',
117→                'query_string': query, 
118→                'page_num': 1
119→            }
120→        elif action.startswith('click['):
121→            button = action[6:-1]
122→            if button == 'Buy Now':
123→                assert self.sessions[session]['page_type'] == 'item'
124→                self.sessions[session]['page_type'] = 'end'
125→                done = True
126→            elif button == 'Back to Search':
127→                assert self.sessions[session]['page_type'] in ['search', 'item_sub', 'item']
128→                self.sessions[session] = {'session': session, 'page_type': 'init'}
129→            elif button == 'Next >':
130→                assert False  # ad hoc page limitation
131→                assert self.sessions[session]['page_type'] == 'search'
132→                self.sessions[session]['page_num'] += 1
133→            elif button == '< Prev':
134→                assert self.sessions[session]['page_type'] in ['search', 'item_sub', 'item']
135→                if self.sessions[session]['page_type'] == 'search':
136→                    assert False
137→                    self.sessions[session]['page_num'] -= 1
138→                elif self.sessions[session]['page_type'] == 'item_sub':
139→                    self.sessions[session]['page_type'] = 'item'
140→                elif self.sessions[session]['page_type'] == 'item':
141→                    self.sessions[session]['page_type'] = 'search'
142→                    self.sessions[session]['options'] = {}
143→            elif button in ACTION_TO_TEMPLATE:
144→                assert self.sessions[session]['page_type'] == 'item'
145→                self.sessions[session]['page_type'] = 'item_sub'
146→                self.sessions[session]['subpage'] = button
147→            else:
148→                if self.sessions[session]['page_type'] == 'search':
149→                    assert button in self.sessions[session].get('asins', [])  # must be asins
150→                    self.sessions[session]['page_type'] = 'item'
151→                    self.sessions[session]['asin'] = button
152→                elif self.sessions[session]['page_type'] == 'item':
153→                    assert 'option_types' in self.sessions[session]
154→                    assert button in self.sessions[session]['option_types'], (button, self.sessions[session]['option_types'])
155→                    option_type = self.sessions[session]['option_types'][button]
156→                    if not 'options' in self.sessions[session]:
157→                        self.sessions[session]['options'] = {}
158→                    self.sessions[session]['options'][option_type] = button
159→                    observation_ = f'You have clicked {button}.'
160→        else:
161→            assert False
162→        
163→        observation, info = webshop_text(**self.sessions[session], webshop_url=self.webshop_url)
164→        if observation_:
165→            observation = observation_
166→        self.sessions[session].update(info)
167→        reward = info.get('reward', 0.0)
168→        return observation, reward, done
